purpose: Resolve whether three exposed-and-negative Class-3 beam rows still possess their historically demonstrated isolated capability on current head before any capability-invention claim.

execution.rationale: 1.5M nodes is >2.5x the largest historical isolated solve cost and should allow these beam searches to exhaust naturally rather than turn a freshness check into a dose check.

decisionRule.allThreeFresh: Current isolated capability survives. Keep rows unresolved and compare fresh isolated-success versus shared-production exhausted-negative execution to localize the earliest context-sensitive loss.
decisionRule.noneFresh: Historical rescuer evidence is stale on current head. Reclassify these rows away from suppressed-current-capability; do not build a consumer around stale capability memory.
decisionRule.mixed: Split the cohort by current capability freshness; do not transport one explanation across all three.
decisionRule.blocked: If wall or node limits bind, raise only enough to obtain natural exhaustion/solve before interpreting freshness.
